description: A utility enumeration providing device and platform information for an iOS application, including functions to retrieve OS version, device family, model identifier, app version, build, and display strings.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the device OS and version, e.g., "iOS 18.0.0" or "iPadOS 18.0.0", based on interface idiom.

methods.name: platformStringForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a display string for the OS version, e.g., "iOS 18.0.0".

methods.name: deviceFamily
methods.description: Returns the device family as a string: "iPad", "iPhone", or "iOS".

methods.name: modelIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the machine model identifier, e.g., "iPhone17,1".

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Returns the app's marketing version string, e.g., "2026.2.0" or "dev".

methods.name: openClawVersionString
methods.description: Returns a combined version string for display, including version and build if different.
